## Requirements (contract § In scope — deliverables)

1. Ledger contract (B3 V1–V6, V8, V9, V11): orient region ≤ 12,288 B (warn >
   8,192); CURRENT STATE 19 keys in order + optional `harness` slot, declared
   vocabularies, lines ≤ 256 B, no PRIOR, `updatedAt` ≤ commit time,
   `nextTicket` = lowest not-landed or DONE; named paths exist; deny-listed
   stale tokens absent; PHASE LOG bold-aware parser + pseudo-id allow-list
   (`SETUP`, `OPERATOR`, `ROUND*`), entries only at the end of the current
   round's section, kinds incl. `correction`/`restored`, ≤ 2,048 B,
   done ⇔ BUILD_INDEX row; BUILD_INDEX unique seq, no placeholders after
   close, rows parse to the header's column count (unescaped `|` fails);
   `returnPass:` = tickets in `### RETURN PASS — current`; GATE DECISIONS
   table form, appended at end, dated ≤ commit; `current_projection.py
   verify` in the `docs` job; orient probe in CI ≤ 48 KiB and resolves
   `nextTicket`.
2. B4 additions: V12 run ledgers name harness + model (trailer check already
   landed, SEED-02); V13 every chain row under a numbered `### Round <n>`
   banner, ids never reused; V14 planning-ledger freshness for
   `docs/build/planning/*/META_PLAN.md`.
3. G11 no-vacuous-pass: every validator/scheduled check reports
   `candidates`/`evaluated`, declares a parse floor, exits 3 when it
   evaluated none of a non-empty set; all run in `make docs-check` and the
   CI `docs` job on PRs and pushes to `main` (SIG-ENG-042).
4. Tests (invariants only, OM-15): pre-seed LEDGER fails V1/V2/V3; seeded
   LEDGER passes; history replay finds the known pseudo-id cases, all
   allow-listed — expected sets derived from history, never pinned counts.
5. Upstream: local patches to the vendored script recorded (SK-15/B6).

Out of scope (do not implement): the RETURN PASS generator (P34.29), the ADR
index generator (P34.32), round-close checks (P34.33), the living-record test
lint (P34.31), append-only modes (P34.7, landed).

## Plan

Baseline findings (this branch @ `7feae0fd`, 2026-10-02): `make docs-check`
green (0 violations, 45 legacy warnings — all warn-level by design);
`check_spec_src.py` OK (777 ids); `check_coverage_matrix.py` 777 rows
evaluated; `check_backlog.py` all-mapped; `audit_current_state.py` exit 1 with
0 errors + 9 conflicts — all 9 reconciled (8 documented in
`reconciliations.json`, `D-P21.5-1` covered by a migration anchor);
`current_projection.py verify` exit 1 — the committed projection is stale
(P34.8's closeout changed LEDGER/COVERAGE_MATRIX/runs after its last
`generate`); `check-build-memory.sh --planning` on META_PLAN green
(104 candidates evaluated).

**Approach — one new tool + small G11 patches to existing validators + wiring:**

1. **`docs/build/tools/ledger_contract.py`** (new; `ledger-contract/1`):
   the G5 contract validator. `check` mode enforces V1–V6, V8, V11, V12,
   V13 against the tree (legacy-region content stays warning-level exactly
   where the vendored script holds it — append-only history cannot be
   edited); `replay FROM..TO` walks `git log --first-parent` LEDGER versions
   read-only and runs the V1/V2/V3/V4-parse checks per version (the
   pseudo-id allow-list audit + the pre-seed failure evidence). Reuses
   `memory_guard.py`'s `Report`/`Finding`/`finish` machinery so the report
   shape and the vacuous exit-3 rule are identical. Per-check
   `candidates`/`evaluated` + a declared floor per check.
   - V4 kinds vocabulary is a declared list:
     `docs/build/tools/record_policy/phase_log_kinds.txt` = B3's set plus
     the Round-11 kinds in use (`ticket`, `post-closeout record`,
     `post-closeout repair`, `orchestrator repair`, `interruption`,
     `harness-switch`); landing kinds = `done|ticket` ⇒ BUILD_INDEX row +
     evidence file.
   - V6 equality: `returnPass:` ⇔ the non-`—` ticket cells of
     `### RETURN PASS — current`. The live table is missing the five P34.x
     keys — **fix-forward**: append the five rows (membership rule: every
     owed OPEN/PARTIAL leg of a landed ticket keys a row) with an appended
     dated repair note; the region is `exempt` in `history.policy`.
2. **`scripts/docs/check-build-memory.sh`** (vendored; SIG-LOCAL hunks,
   recorded in the header list + here for SK-15/B6):
   - L4: `count()` flags the check when `candidates > 0 && evaluated == 0`
     (G11 generalised — today only `phase-log-done` sets VACUOUS);
   - L5: the orient probe > 48 KiB is `guarded` (fail under the guards
     marker), not warn-only;
   - L6: `OPERATOR` joins the done-entry pseudo-id allow-list (B3's
     allow-list).
   - `docs/build/tools/record_policy/stale_tokens.txt` (new): the shared
     deny list — `.agents/scratch`, `gitignored`, `never commit`,
     `PHASE PLAN`, `Do not resume until`; the vendored script reads it when
     present, so the full V3 list lands without forking its logic.
3. **G11 on the named validators:**
   - `memory_guard.py` — already compliant (per-check counts + exit 3).
   - `check_spec_src.py` — add per-check candidates/evaluated + exit 3 when
     a non-empty input evaluated nothing.
   - `check_coverage_matrix.py` — already reports offered/evaluated; the
     empty-input case exits 3 instead of collapsing into the generic 1.
   - `check_backlog.py` — name candidates/evaluated in the printed stats +
     exit 3 when a non-empty source evaluated none.
   - `audit_current_state.py` — add `counts` (per-input
     candidates/evaluated), a `--require-reconciled` mode that treats
     conflicts covered by `reconciliations.json` or a migration-anchor
     interpretation as reported-not-failing (ambiguity otherwise stays
     open — unreconciled conflicts still exit 1), and exit 3 on vacuous.
   - `current_projection.py verify` — report `candidates` (manifested
     inputs) / `evaluated` (digests verified) and exit 3 when the manifest
     offers inputs and none verify; regenerate the stale projection.
   - `check_trailers.py`, `verify_recorded_ci.py` — already report counts +
     exit 3 (verify in passing).
   - Scheduled checks: the nightly `replay` stage already exits 3 on a
     vacuous span (P34.7); the nightly report gate fails on any red stage.
4. **Wiring:** `Makefile docs-check` gains `docs-check-ledger`
   (ledger_contract check), `docs-check-audit` (`--require-reconciled`),
   `docs-check-projection` (`current_projection.py verify`),
   `docs-check-planning` (vendored `--planning` over each
   `docs/build/planning/*/META_PLAN.md`), and `check_backlog.py` joins
   `docs-check-matrix`. The CI `docs` job runs `make docs-check` on PRs and
   pushes to `main` — no job loosening, the new targets ride along; an
   explicit step keeps the projection verify visible (V9).
5. **Closeout records:** run ledger, `docs/build/pr/P34.9.md`, BUILD_INDEX
   row 211 under `## Round 11` (12 cols), LEDGER advance + PHASE LOG `done`
   entry, README `rows 1-211`, memory-repair archive lines for replaced
   CURRENT STATE lines, regenerated `docs/build/reports/current/` in the
   same commit so `verify` is green at the closeout head.

## Deferrals and deviations

None opened; none closed. Deviations:

- `audit_current_state.py` stays advisory by default (its 9 conflict diags);
  `docs-check-audit` runs `--require-reconciled`, which fails only on
  unreconciled conflicts — the reconcile set is the P32.7 register plus
  migration-anchor `reconciled`/`ambiguous-open` interpretations (the same two
  sets `classify_conflicts` uses).
- `phase_log_kinds.txt` defaults are mirrored in `DEFAULT_KINDS` so `replay`
  over commits that predate the policy file judges with the same vocabulary
  (the file only extends at runtime).
- GATE DECISIONS `answer-empty` is a violation (the operator's verbatim words
  are the record); an unquoted-but-non-empty answer stays a warning.
